message.reasoning_content: We need to identify crimes based on facts. The facts: Defendant Xu sold a house that he had already sold to someone else, concealed truth, signed transfer agreement with victim, defrauded 480k RMB, used to repay personal debt. This is fraud (诈骗). Specifically, "合同诈骗" (contract fraud) because he used a house transfer contract. In Chinese criminal law, "诈骗罪" is the crime. Could also be "非法占有他人财物" but it's fraud. So the charge: 诈骗罪. Possibly "诈骗罪" is enough. The fact mentions "隐瞒事实真相" and "骗取钱财". So answer: [罪名]诈骗<eoa>.
